name: Audio Tagging
description: Describes what you can hear in a clip, a section or the whole timeline, and finds the moments that match a sound like a whoosh, applause or rain.
details: LAION CLAP (HTSAT audio encoder, laion/larger_clap_general) in ONNX with fp16 weights. Drift turns audio into a 512-number fingerprint and compares it with a built-in vocabulary of 322 sound, music and ambience descriptions and 49 sound-effect phrases, scored with the calibration from the earshot project (MIT). Used for sound tags on events and sections, searching a clip for a sound and ranking media by how well it matches. No text model is installed: the vocabulary is precomputed. Package id: audio.clap.
author: CutWire
